description: About us: We advocate a happy childhood, with "safety, comfort, health" as the design concept of this brand. Integrating art and beauty into every rug play mat, let children have curiosity, happiness and true attitude in childhood, so that they are full of yearning for life and grow up healthily. With the companionship of this toy carpet, there will be many ordinary but happy stories! Bring your children a different childhoods: This toy carpet, printed with a map of the city's traffic, is moisture-proof, isolated from the cold and has a certain cushioning power so that child can avoid the cold attack during crawling and reduce the damage caused by wrestling. Children can move all their cars to the carpet, even combine with traffic signs, role-playing, etc., so that children can understand the various traffic rules in the game and understand each role plays in society , improve the child's practical ability. Parents can play with children together, this is not only deepen the relationship between parents and children, it also bring more imagination , fun and entertaining to your child.
